title: scene.request (viewer → relay)
description: Viewer asks to re-synchronise after a gap, reconnect, checksum mismatch or user action (docs/protocol.md §8.3). The relay answers with scene.snapshot.ready when haveSnapshotVersion differs from its cached snapshot, then scene.state.

haveSnapshotVersion.description: Version of the GLB the viewer holds, or null when it has none (§8.3).

haveSceneVersion.description: Last scene version the viewer applied; 0 when none (§8.3, §8.4).
